responsibility: Declares the THIR-building submodules for MIR construction, grouping literal conversion, HIR-to-THIR lowering, pattern handling, THIR printing, and shared THIR utilities under the `thir` module.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files that implement active lowering logic, this one is primarily the namespace root for THIR support in the crate, declaring the THIR-related submodules rather than driving body conversion, pattern lowering internals, MIR construction, match lowering, or custom MIR parsing.
